title: [Subcontracting] Refresh the transfer order lines without saving in SetIsSubcontracting
summary: SetIsSubcontracting on the Subc. Trans. Order Sub. page extension now calls CurrPage.Update(false), so it refreshes the transfer lines subform without saving the current line. This stops a failed line save from being raised inside the Transfer Order's record-fetch trigger and closing the page.
key_points: CurrPage.Update() replaced by CurrPage.Update(false) in SetIsSubcontracting
Transfer Order calls it from OnOpenPage and OnAfterGetCurrRecord, so before this each header fetch saved the current line
A save error no longer surfaces inside OnAfterGetCurrRecord and closes the page
Edited lines are still saved by the normal page save, for example when leaving the row
Matches how SetPerTaskBillingFieldsVisible refreshes the Job Task Lines subform from the Job Card
